stories.title: Chhattisgarh recruitment rules target appointment letters within 40 days
stories.summary: Chhattisgarh introduced 2026 rules for Group III and IV government recruitment, aiming to speed results and issue appointments within 40 days. The revised process reportedly removes waiting lists, changing how vacant posts are filled after examinations.

stories.title: Handloom initiative helps rural women build businesses beyond weaving skills
stories.summary: SwitchON Foundation's Udyamini project supports rural women with enterprise development alongside technical handloom skills, according to EastMojo. The programme links production knowledge with leadership and business support intended to help participants grow income-generating ventures.
stories.why_it_matters: Weavers often face weak market access and limited control over pricing. Business skills and collective leadership can help women retain more value from their work.

stories.title: Supreme Court reopens dispute over retrospective spectrum charges
stories.summary: The Supreme Court asked Bharti Airtel and Vodafone Idea to respond to the Centre's effort to restore one-time charges on spectrum held above 6.2 MHz between 2008 and 2012. The Bombay High Court had struck down the retrospective demands as unsupported by law or telecom licences.
stories.why_it_matters: The case concerns substantial liabilities for major operators and will influence how far the government can impose retrospective costs on licensed infrastructure businesses.
stories.evidence_status: Bar & Bench reports the notice, charging period and High Court reasoning. The Supreme Court has not decided whether the levy is valid or payable.

stories.title: Kerala High Court extends 45-day hysterectomy leave to contract staff
stories.summary: The Kerala High Court held that women working for the state on contracts must receive the same 45 days of post-hysterectomy leave available to regular employees. The case arose after special educators supplied medical documents but were denied leave because of their employment status.
stories.why_it_matters: Equal medical leave prevents contract status from forcing women to choose between recovery and income, and may influence benefits across other public programmes.

stories.title: Free coaching centre brings Sapera children into regular education
stories.summary: A community-run coaching centre in Kapari village serves poor and previously excluded children from the Sapera community. Khabar Lahariya reports that about 95% of local Sapera children are now receiving free teaching through the Ek Pahal Shiksha Samiti initiative.
stories.why_it_matters: Regular learning support can interrupt intergenerational exclusion for a marginalised community, but long-term progress depends on school enrolment, attendance and recognised qualifications.

stories.title: Supreme Court creates coordination bodies for Rajasthan river restoration
stories.summary: The Supreme Court ordered two integrated coordination groups and a separate restoration body to address industrial contamination of Rajasthan waterways, including the Jojari River. They must work with an existing high-powered committee and submit a comprehensive resolution plan before the September 22 hearing.
stories.why_it_matters: A court-mandated structure may overcome fragmented enforcement, but cleaner water depends on stopping industrial discharge, funding restoration and publishing measurable targets.

stories.title: New US birthright-citizenship rules create uncertainty for Indian families
